docs.text: My Docs as Code stack I'm using these tools in the pipeline. Authoring I write markdown files with Notepad++ . I use the following plugins: AnotherMarkdown Versioning I use Git on Windows locally. I host the repository on GitHub. Open the repository To operate GitHub I use GitHub CLI in a PowerShell terminal. I'm authenticated via a Github token (the classic type) and communicating through HTTPS. Static site generator I use mkDocs to generate and serve a local version of the docs site.
